datasets.name: Open Images V7 — SentinelX subset
datasets.license: Annotations CC BY 4.0 (Google LLC); images listed as CC BY 2.0 (per-image author recorded)
datasets.access: public (official GCS annotation files, CVDF S3 image mirror)
datasets.redistribution: Annotations (derived YOLO labels) committed with attribution; images NOT committed (size) — re-downloaded by script

datasets.name: ATM Anomaly Video Dataset (ATMA-V)
datasets.used_for: end-to-end threat pipeline calibration (train/val) and evaluation (test)
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (as declared on Kaggle by the uploader)
datasets.redistribution: The 65 videos were already committed to this repository before SentinelX (data/videos/). CC BY-SA 4.0 permits redistribution with attribution and share-alike; attribution is in data/videos/ATTRIBUTION.md. Caveat: the uploader states the clips were collected from YouTube, stock-footage and news sites, so upstream rights are not guaranteed by the Kaggle licence.
datasets.notes: 14 videos' containers over-report frame counts by 1–131 frames; all labelled segments lie within decodable frames (see manifest validation_notes).

datasets.name: Surveillance Camera Fight Dataset
datasets.used_for: evaluation of fighting / struggle rules (val = tuning, test = report)
datasets.redistribution: Not committed — clips were cut from YouTube videos; fetched on demand by script

datasets.name: UCF-Crime (Real-world Anomaly Detection in Surveillance Videos)
datasets.license: Official page: 'All data is only for research purposes, unless stated differently. Please make sure to reference the authors properly.'
datasets.access: public download (UCF zip / Dropbox parts), ~128 h, 1,900 videos, 13 anomaly classes incl. Robbery, Burglary, Fighting, Vandalism
datasets.blocker: Archive is on the order of 100 GB; this machine had 48 GB free disk. Labels are video-level (temporal only for test), so it would serve the pipeline evaluation, not detector training. Research-only terms.
datasets.reproducible_alternative: python -m ml.datasets.ucf_crime --accept-research-terms --classes Robbery Fighting Vandalism (downloads only the temporal annotation file unless --videos is given)

datasets.name: XD-Violence
datasets.license: No licence or usage terms stated on the official page
datasets.access: Baidu Netdisk / AliyunDrive / OneDrive links (Baidu training link marked disabled)
datasets.blocker: No stated licence; 217 h (4,754 videos); includes movie/game footage, weak labels.

datasets.name: RWF-2000 (violence detection)
datasets.license: No modification/redistribution or commercial use without SMIIP Lab approval
datasets.access: Official page: video files currently not available for privacy reasons
datasets.blocker: Videos not publicly available; requires lab approval.

datasets.name: CUHK Avenue
datasets.license: No licence stated on the official page; citation requested (Lu, Shi, Jia, ICCV 2013)
datasets.blocker: No licence stated; campus walkway (running, throwing objects) — weak relevance to ATM vestibules.

datasets.name: ShanghaiTech Campus
datasets.license: Not verified on the official page (third-party docs claim BSD-2-Clause)
datasets.blocker: Licence not verifiable from the official source; campus scenes (437 videos), not ATM.

datasets.name: UCSD Anomaly Detection (Ped1/Ped2)
datasets.blocker: Official site unreachable during research (connection refused); pedestrian walkways only.

datasets.name: UBnormal
datasets.blocker: Synthetic (virtual scenes); NoDerivatives licence forbids distributing derived labels.

datasets.name: VIRAT Video Dataset (ground camera)
datasets.license: Ground-camera data under the 'VIRAT Video Dataset Protection Agreement'
datasets.blocker: Requires signing the protection agreement; outdoor parking-lot scenes.

datasets.name: OD-WeaponDetection (University of Granada, DaSCI)
datasets.license: README states CC BY-SA 4.0; repository sidebar says CC BY 4.0 (inconsistent)
datasets.blocker: Licence statement is internally inconsistent and the archive is on Google Drive (no scripted, verifiable download). Candidate for v2 once the licence is confirmed with the authors; Open Images already provides Knife/Handgun/Rifle/Shotgun boxes under a clear licence.
